'''Deepterror Mixin''' is a {{Rare}} [[Mixins|Mixin]] that can be brewed with a {{Item|God Potion}} to grant it an additional effect for its duration.

== Usage ==
=== Brewing ===
A '''Deepterror Mixin''' can be brewed with a {{Item|God Potion}} to grant the player {{stat|hp|+210}} and {{stat|def|+40}} when on {{zone|The End}} and {{zone|Crimson Isle}}. This effect lasts for the {{Item|God Potion}}'s entire duration.

=== Consuming ===
If the [[Booster Cookie|Cookie Buff]] is active, '''Mixins''' can also be consumed directly by right clicking them. This will provide {{Green|3x}} their normal duration (since a Mixin can be applied to up to {{Green|3}} [[God Potion]]s). The timer is separate from the {{Item|God Potion}} timer and is paused if a God Potion is no longer active. The player cannot consume '''Mixins''' they do not meet the requirements for.
== Trivia ==
* The '''Deepterror Mixin''' was the first [[Mixin]] with an associated crafting recipe.
** The {{Item|Celestial Mason Jar}}, {{Item|Melon Juice Mixin}}, and {{Item|Hotspot Tonic Mixin}} were added later.
